name: GoldenEye VR
summary: GoldenEye 007 running natively on Meta Quest: a free, from-source port of the N64 classic built on the GoldenEye decompilation. Play in true stereo VR, aiming with your hand and looking at Bond's watch on your wrist, or on a giant flat or curved virtual screen. In-VR launcher, laser-pointer menus, smooth or snap turning, comfort vignette, 120 Hz. Bring your own GoldenEye 007 (USA) ROM; no game data included.
